questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code validates the order payload? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A client posts {"customer_ref": "c-1", "currency": "USD", "lines": [{"sku": "AB-1234", "quantity": 2}], "gift": true}. What happens?
choices: The order is created and "gift" is ignored
The request fails with 422 because the model forbids extra fields
The request fails with 400 because "gift" is not a known field of the view
The order is created and "gift" is stored on the model as an attribute

questions.prompt: What does the view do if the second of three order lines cannot be reserved because of insufficient stock?
choices: Returns 201 with the reservations that succeeded
Returns 409 and keeps the first reservation so a retry can reuse it
Returns 422 because stock problems are validation errors
Returns 409 after releasing the reservation made for the first line

questions.prompt: A request body is the JSON array [{"sku": "AB-1234"}]. What is returned?
choices: 400 with "body must be a JSON object"
422 with a list of problems from OrderIn
201 because arrays are coerced into the lines field
